title: Crestline Battery Installation Service Menu — Battery Replacement Warranties Lines
content:
Installation charges at Crestline stores differ by battery line. The menu below lists, for each line sold with Battery Replacement Warranties, the fee for an under-hood battery, the fee for a battery under a seat, in the trunk or requiring component removal, the charge to register a new battery with the vehicle's battery management system where the vehicle requires it, the recycling handling fee per old battery taken, what every installation includes, and whether a fleet account's battery discount applies when the battery is charged to a fleet account.

## Menu (USD; 0.00 means no charge)

| Line | Under-hood installation | Under-seat, trunk or component-removal installation | Battery management system registration, where the vehicle requires it | Recycling handling fee per old battery taken |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Standard 24-Month Battery | 0.00 | 39.99 | 24.99 | 0.00 |
| Crestline Plus 30-Month Battery | 0.00 | 39.99 | 24.99 | 0.00 |
| Crestline Gold 36-Month Battery | 0.00 | 29.99 | 24.99 | 0.00 |
| Crestline AGM 36-Month Battery | 0.00 | 29.99 | 19.99 | 0.00 |
| Crestline Platinum AGM 48-Month Battery | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery | 0.00 | 39.99 | 24.99 | 0.00 |

## Included with every installation, and fleet accounts

| Line | Terminal cleaning and anti-corrosion treatment included | Memory saver connected during installation | Fleet account's battery discount applies when charged to a fleet account |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Standard 24-Month Battery | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Crestline Plus 30-Month Battery | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Crestline Gold 36-Month Battery | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Crestline AGM 36-Month Battery | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Crestline Platinum AGM 48-Month Battery | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Reading the menu

- An under-hood installation carries no fee on any line.
- The Crestline Platinum AGM 48-Month Battery carries no installation fee in either position and no registration charge.
- The registration charge is 24.99 on four lines, 19.99 on the Crestline AGM 36-Month Battery and 0.00 on the Crestline Platinum AGM 48-Month Battery, and it arises only where the vehicle requires battery registration.
